name: – Adam Jarubas – Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – after § 2b – Am 14
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: 2bb. By way of derogation from paragraph 1, third and fifth subparagraphs, the 20 % reduction of free allocation pursuant to those subparagraphs shall not take into account the update of the heat and fuel benchmark values pursuant to paragraph 2a
